name: Endbringer Behemoth
description: (Tag:blood)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:poison)A Shard Superweapon reformed by Chaos and toughest of the three siblings, Behemoth is a giant that manipulates energy to fire lightning, create flames, release shockwaves, redirect projectiles, and absorb existing energy to a limit. He also emits extreme radiation and has incredible strength and durability as the physically strongest Endbringer. (A/N: Scaled down to multi-country level)
